# .github

## Purpose

GitHub configuration. Currently CI only — no issue templates, PR templates or Actions beyond the build.

## Subdirectories

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `workflows/` | CI workflow definitions (see `workflows/AGENTS.md`) |

## For AI Agents

### Working In This Directory

Workflow files use the `.yaml` extension, not `.yml` — standardized in commit `686a867`, so a new file must match.
